stemMd: A parallelepiped is represented by projected edge vectors u, v and w from one vertex. Which expression locates its opposite vertex?
explanationMd: To reach the opposite corner, traverse one edge in each of the three positive edge directions. Parallel projection preserves vector addition, so the projected displacement is the sum of the three edge vectors.

distractorRationale.d: The negative height direction reaches a different point.
distractorRationale.e: A cross product gives a normal-related vector, not the opposite vertex.
distractorRationale.b: This is an average of adjacent vertices, not the far corner.
